en.title: Remake of ‘The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time’ discussed in CNN interview
en.description: CNN reports that a remake of the 1998 title The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has been released for newer consoles and a new generation of playe...
en.fullContent:
CNN reports that a remake of the 1998 title The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has been released for newer consoles and a new generation of players, and it is characterized as a departure from the original version.

In the segment titled “Game On,” journalist Rick Damigella speaks with Victor Lucas about the remake, outlining its features and differences from the earlier release.

The broadcast includes a QR code that directs viewers to download the CNN app from the Apple Store. © 2026 Cable News Network. All Rights Reserved. CNN Sans ™ & © 2016 Cable News Network.

en.fullContent:
The latest issue focuses on the remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. The review notes that the author collected every heart piece, every Gold Skulltula, the Goron Sword, and the largest item pouch during play. The article also includes an interview with the game's producers, information about Easter eggs that were added or omitted, and a tip for using a Switch 2 Pro controller.

The forthcoming cover of the magazine is announced as Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, which will be accompanied by a cover story and a retrospective on the series. The author states a recommendation for readers to subscribe if they have not already done so.

World of Warcraft: Forever has been released, adding a thousand new quests, multiple new zones, various revamps, and a visual overhaul.

El artículo también incluye una entrevista con los productores del juego, información sobre los Easter Eggs que se añadieron o no, y un consejo para usar el controlador Switch 2 Pro.

Se anuncia la próxima portada de la revista, titulada Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, que irá acompañada de una historia de portada y una retrospectiva de la serie. El autor menciona una recomendación para que los lectores se suscriban si aún no lo han hecho.

en.title: SAG-AFTRA introduces Pre-Funding Pitch Interactive Media Agreement for video game projects
en.description: SAG-AFTRA has announced a new collective bargaining agreement called the Pre-Funding Pitch Interactive Media Agreement, which is intended to simpli...
en.fullContent:
SAG-AFTRA has announced a new collective bargaining agreement called the Pre-Funding Pitch Interactive Media Agreement, which is intended to simplify the process of hiring union actors for early-stage video game materials. The agreement applies to demos, vertical slices, trailers, teasers, sizzle reels and playable prototypes that are used to pitch a project before securing full funding.

To be eligible, a project may not have more than 30 percent of its initial production budget secured and must not appear to be completed. Projects funded through crowdfunding are excluded, and the agreement does not cover titles that are commercially released or made publicly playable. The union indicates that developers who meet some but not all of the criteria may request a waiver.

es.title: SAG‑AFTRA lanza nuevo acuerdo de videojuegos para presentaciones previas a la financiación
es.description: SAG‑AFTRA ha presentado el Pre‑Funding Pitch Interactive Media Agreement, un convenio que busca simplificar la contratación de actores sindicalizad...
es.fullContent:
SAG‑AFTRA ha presentado el Pre‑Funding Pitch Interactive Media Agreement, un convenio que busca simplificar la contratación de actores sindicalizados para materiales de videojuegos en fases tempranas. El acuerdo abarca demos, vertical slices, tráilers, teasers, sizzle reels y prototipos jugables utilizados en presentaciones antes de obtener la financiación completa.

Los proyectos que deseen acogerse al convenio no pueden tener más del 30 % del presupuesto inicial de producción asegurado ni presentar indicios de estar finalizados. Además, los proyectos financiados mediante crowdfunding quedan excluidos, al igual que aquellos que se publiquen comercialmente o se pongan a disposición del público para jugar. La unión señala que, si un proyecto cumple parcialmente los requisitos, los desarrolladores pueden solicitar una exención.

en.title: Cat pulls out headphone plug while owner plays video game
en.description: A video posted by @just.siggiandbryn shows a cat named Siggi interrupting a gaming session by removing the headphone plug from the computer. The fo...
en.fullContent:
A video posted by @just.siggiandbryn shows a cat named Siggi interrupting a gaming session by removing the headphone plug from the computer. The footage begins with the owner seated in front of a dual‑monitor setup, playing a game, while the cat is positioned on a nearby speaker. Siggi sniffs the auxiliary cable, grabs the plug with her mouth, and pulls it out of the socket, causing the audio to stop.

A hand then reaches into the frame to reconnect the headphones, allowing the game to continue. The owner’s caption notes that this was the third or fourth occurrence of the behavior and that it was captured on camera. The clip has received more than 25,100 likes, and comments from viewers mention similar experiences with pets interfering with electronic devices.

es.title: Gato desconecta auriculares mientras su dueño juega
es.description: Un video compartido por @just.siggiandbryn muestra a una gata llamada Siggi interrumpiendo una partida al retirar el conector de los auriculares de...
es.fullContent:
Un video compartido por @just.siggiandbryn muestra a una gata llamada Siggi interrumpiendo una partida al retirar el conector de los auriculares del ordenador. La grabación comienza con su dueño sentado frente a dos monitores, jugando, mientras la gata está sobre un altavoz cercano. Siggi huele el cable auxiliar, agarra el enchufe con la boca y lo saca del puerto, lo que corta el sonido.

Una mano vuelve a entrar en la escena para volver a conectar los auriculares y la partida continúa. En el pie de foto, el dueño indica que este es el tercer o cuarto intento de la gata y que logró grabarlo. El clip ha superado los 25.100 "me gusta" y varios comentarios de usuarios relatan situaciones similares con sus mascotas y dispositivos electrónicos.

en.title: EA releases 25 classic games from its archive on Steam and GOG
en.description: Electronic Arts has made 25 titles from its internal archive available for purchase on Steam and GOG. The collection includes seven releases that f...
en.fullContent:
Electronic Arts has made 25 titles from its internal archive available for purchase on Steam and GOG. The collection includes seven releases that feature technical enhancements and 18 ports that preserve the original experience for current platforms. Among the titles are early entries from the Wing Commander franchise and several games from the Ultima series.

The material was found in 2022 when a senior producer, Jim Vessella, was cleaning up Betacam tapes related to the Command & Conquer Remastered Collection. A facilities employee directed him to a storage room at EA’s Redwood Shores campus that contained roughly 20,000 archival media assets, including tapes, film reels and CD-ROMs. A small team was assembled to catalog and digitize the assets, and a business case was presented to EA leadership for commercial re‑release.

Vessella coordinated with members of the Wing Commander fan community through a Slack channel to iterate on a restoration of Wing Commander III. According to his blog, the process involved community members providing builds on a public GitHub repository, followed by play‑testing and feedback from Vessella and his team.

es.title: EA lanza 25 juegos clásicos de su archivo en Steam y GOG
es.description: Electronic Arts ha puesto a la venta 25 títulos de su archivo interno en las plataformas Steam y GOG. La colección incluye siete versiones con mejo...
es.fullContent:
Electronic Arts ha puesto a la venta 25 títulos de su archivo interno en las plataformas Steam y GOG. La colección incluye siete versiones con mejoras técnicas y 18 puertos que conservan la experiencia original en plataformas actuales. Entre los juegos se encuentran los primeros títulos de la saga Wing Commander y varios de la serie Ultima.

El material fue descubierto en 2022 cuando el productor senior Jim Vessella estaba limpiando cintas Betacam vinculadas al proyecto Command & Conquer Remastered Collection. Un empleado de instalaciones lo dirigió a una sala de almacenamiento en el campus de Redwood Shores de EA, donde se hallaban aproximadamente 20 000 activos de archivo, entre los que se encontraban cintas, carretes de película y CD‑ROM. Se formó un pequeño equipo para catalogar y digitalizar los activos, y se presentó un caso de negocio a la dirección de EA para su re‑lanzamiento comercial.

Vessella trabajó con miembros de la comunidad de fans de Wing Commander mediante un canal de Slack para iterar en la restauración de Wing Commander III. Según su blog, el proceso consistió en que la comunidad subía compilaciones a un repositorio público de GitHub, seguidas de pruebas de juego y retroalimentación por parte de Vessella y su equipo.
